zh.title: 租賃商Avolon向空中巴士確認訂購110架飛機
zh.summary: Avolon確認訂購35架A330-900與75架A320neo系列；A330-900累計達114架
body: 空中巴士（Airbus）於2026年10月9日發布消息指出，全球航空金融公司Avolon已確認訂購110架空中巴士飛機，其中包括35架A330-900與75架A320neo系列飛機。空中巴士在新聞稿中將這筆交易形容為確認訂單（firm order）。
空中巴士表示，這筆增購使Avolon的A330-900訂單總數達到114架，A320系列則約達650架。空中巴士商用飛機業務銷售執行副總裁Benoît de Saint-Exupéry指出，Avolon已成為A330-900的主要租賃商。
Avolon執行長Andy Cronin表示，公司持續看到新飛機的強勁需求，這筆訂單進一步強化其長期交機排程，並讓公司能夠支援航空公司客戶機隊成長與汰換需求。他並表示，基於航空業的長期成長軌跡，預期A330neo與A320neo的需求都將維持強勁。
空中巴士在新聞稿中說明，A330neo採用勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）Trent 7000發動機，設計可不停站飛行最高8,100海里、約15,000公里，相較前一代競爭機型可降低25%燃油消耗、二氧化碳排放與營運成本。
空中巴士指出，A320系列是全球最受歡迎的單走道飛機，全球已贏得超過20,400架訂單；該系列中最大成員為A321neo。空中巴士表示，該系列相較前一代單走道飛機可節省至少20%燃油並減少二氧化碳排放。

en.title: Lessor Avolon places firm order for 110 Airbus aircraft
en.summary: Avolon orders 35 A330-900 and 75 A320neo Family jets; A330-900 total reaches 114
body: Airbus said on 9 October 2026 that Avolon, described as a leading global aviation finance company, has placed a firm order for 110 Airbus aircraft, comprising 35 A330-900 and 75 A320neo Family aircraft.

According to the announcement, the incremental order takes Avolon's total for the A330-900 to 114 aircraft and its A320 Family total to some 650. Airbus EVP Sales of the Commercial Aircraft business Benoît de Saint-Exupéry said the acquisition confirms Avolon's position as the leading lessor for the A330-900, having purchased 114 of the type from Airbus.

Avolon CEO Andy Cronin said the company continues to see strong demand for new aircraft and that the order further strengthens its long-term delivery pipeline, positioning it to support airline customers' fleet growth and replacement requirements well into the next decade. He said demand for both the A330neo and A320neo is expected to remain strong given the long-term growth trajectory of the aviation sector.

Airbus said the A330neo is powered by the latest generation Rolls-Royce Trent 7000 engines and is designed to fly up to 8,100 nautical miles / 15,000 kilometres non-stop, reducing fuel burn, CO2 emissions and operating cost by 25% compared to previous generation competitor aircraft.

Airbus also said the A320 Family is the world's most popular single-aisle aircraft, having won more than 20,400 orders globally, and includes its largest member, the A321neo. The manufacturer said the Family offers at least 20% fuel savings and CO2 reduction compared to previous generation single-aisle aircraft.
